name: write-scope
purpose: P-C2 item 6: every audited instrument whose SKILL.md write-scope cell makes a checkable claim is exercised in a sandbox and the claim is compared with the bytes the run actually leaves behind.

source.header: | name | kind | entry | verdict map | self-test | pinned values | write scope | owner |
source.attribution: a row attributes a path only through its entry cell naming that exact repo-relative path; the last such row in document order supersedes earlier ones

check.sandbox: the lane repo at --rev (or the working tree with --work) copied to $TMPDIR/mori-writescope-<pid>-<rnd>/lane
check.tmpdir: each instrument runs with TMPDIR=$TMPDIR/mori-writescope-<pid>-<rnd>/tmp/<id>, i.e. outside lane/
check.digest: sorted `find lane -type f -exec sha256sum {} +` plus a sorted listing of every path under the sandbox parent, before and after the run
check.repo_unchanged: no path under lane/ is created, modified or deleted by the run
check.writes_outside_tmpdir: count of created, modified or deleted paths that are not under tmp/<id>/

verdict.TRUE: repo_unchanged=yes, writes_outside_tmpdir=0, rc matches expect.rc and every expect.stdout_contains token is present
verdict.FALSE: a created, modified or deleted path outside tmp/<id>/ was observed (the declared cell is contradicted by bytes)
verdict.UNEXERCISED: no write was observed, but the run did not reach expect.rc/expect.stdout_contains, so the claim was not exercised
verdict.UNAVAILABLE: the instrument is absent at the measured revision, or no committed write-scope cell names it

exit.0: no checkable entry is FALSE or UNEXERCISED and at least one entry was TRUE
exit.1: a checkable entry is FALSE or UNEXERCISED
exit.2: setup: TMPDIR missing or /tmp, fixture unreadable, revision unresolvable, or nothing exerciseable

entries.declared: stdout only; reads the repo at `--rev`; the selftest writes only under the caller TMPDIR
entries.claim: the instrument writes no file inside the repo; its selftest writes only under the caller TMPDIR

entries.declared: stdout only; counter bytes materialize under the caller TMPDIR; nothing in the repo is written
entries.claim: counter bytes go under the caller TMPDIR and nothing in the repo is written

entries.declared: stdout only; the registry copy handed to the census is materialized under the caller TMPDIR
entries.claim: the registry copy handed to the census goes under the caller TMPDIR, not into the repo

entries.declared: stdout only; reads the registry and the audited paths at `--rev`; the selftest writes only under the caller TMPDIR
entries.claim: the instrument writes no file inside the repo; its selftest writes only under the caller TMPDIR

entries.note: no committed SKILL.md write-scope cell at fixture time: the round-45 counter rows were still being drafted. The runner re-derives the cell from the measured revision, so this entry becomes checkable, and is checked, as soon as a row's entry cell names the path; until then the run reports it UNAVAILABLE, never TRUE.
